checks.name: standalone load, exact banner, labels and native keyboard focus
typed errors retain baseline/history and semantic guards are visible
nominal update keeps old route and cannot claim readiness or traffic
ready permits but does not observe replacement; independent switch and continuity
failed and unknown readiness keep old active at 100% without traffic claims
mismatching or unknown current traffic does not masquerade as replacement
session failures and old-work failures/unknowns remain independent measured results
history bound retains twelve actions and keyboard reset restores state/focus
a control named reset does not shadow the real reset operation
actual CSP blocks script/event/style, eval, connection, image, frame and form attempts
missing local model fails visibly and normal reload/reset recovers safely
no unexpected page exceptions or HTTP/WebSocket requests
